task_name: On the Chase official calculator hosted at static.chasecdn.com (the supplied starting page), determine the projected 401(k)/403(b) value at retirement using current age 22, retirement age 65, annual return 3%, annual employee contributions $8,000, and annual employer contributions $8,000. Use the calculator’s default assumptions, including its fixed 12% retirement tax rate, and report the displayed after-tax estimate. Return only a JSON object with a numeric dollar amount: {"after_tax_value": number}. Leave the calculator open with these inputs and its calculated result displayed.

source.original_task_name: Using a calculator to determine how much I can have in my 401(k) account at retirement, if I work from age 22 to 65, with an annual rate of return of 3%, annual employee contributions of $8,000, and annual employer contributions of $8,000.
source.intent_modified_reason: Kept all five inputs and the retirement-value calculation. The task starts on the official calculator page that chase.com embeds, because on the chase.com page the calculator sits in a cross-origin iframe that the verifier's top-level-document evidence cannot read; finding the calculator is not a hidden condition. The calculator's fixed 12% retirement tax rate and its after-tax result are stated to remove the pre-tax / after-tax ambiguity. The answer is a JSON object with a numeric after_tax_value, and the result page must stay open.

must_include: At age 65 my 401(k)/403(b) is estimated to be worth
